sources.entry: CoworkingView MCP - Hosted MCP server and REST API that let AI assistants search and compare coworking spaces and private offices in Europe and the UAE, with operator-published prices. #free #mcp

summary.name: CoworkingView MCP Server
summary.one_liner: A free, read-only, no-sign-up hosted MCP server and REST API that lets AI assistants search and compare coworking spaces and private offices in Europe and the UAE using operator-published prices.
use_cases: Finding a private office within a monthly budget
Shortlisting spaces by amenities like phone booths or 24/7 access
Briefing a team relocation across cities
Checking typical market rates for a desk or office in a city
summary.what_it_does: The server exposes ten read-only tools over Streamable HTTP. They let an assistant search coworking spaces by city, zone, price, workspace type, amenities or map area, and pull full details for one space including pricing options, amenities, photos and the date prices were last checked. Other tools compare two to five spaces side by side, list covered countries, cities and districts, and return market rate medians with sample size and date for desks, private offices, day passes and meeting rooms. A best-of-city ranking orders spaces only within a single city. Prices are "from" prices shown in the local currency without conversion.
notable: Read-only and unauthenticated: no API key, OAuth or sign-up needed
Market rate figures always include the number of spaces or pricing options and the date they reflect
Listed in the official MCP registry and on Smithery
Covers coworking in Europe and the UAE with prices from the operators themselves
caveats: Prices are 'from' prices at the cheapest option of each type, not final quotes
ChatGPT custom connectors require a Plus or Pro plan with developer mode enabled
Requests are rate-limited per IP address
Catalogue coverage is still growing; some cities are missing
Terms forbid presenting the catalogue as your own or redistributing it in bulk
